items.author: iveplayedit.bsky.social
items.context: Detroit: Become Human has been in my Steam library for years. Still haven't played it. Every sale I think "this is the one." What's yours?
items.text: Detroit plays a lot like an interactive film, so it's easy to start with just one chapter on a quiet evening. Sometimes starting it matters more than catching the sale.

items.author: epudds.bsky.social
items.context: I don't plan on buying it for console, happy to wait for a sale on PC but it's great to see so many people having an enthusiastic great time with a game.
items.text: Waiting for a PC sale is a fair call. If it's on your Steam wishlist, you'll get a notification when the price drops.
